identity.name: DB28
identity.one_liner: De Bethune's signature case, suspended from lugs that pivot independently to follow the wrist rather than sitting fixed against it.

narrative.story: The DB28, introduced in 2011, built De Bethune's floating-lug construction into its own model line rather than as a one-off case detail: the lugs pivot independently on their own bearings so the case follows the curve of the wrist instead of forcing the wrist to conform to a fixed lug angle. De Bethune, founded by Denis Flageollet and David Zanetta in 2002, had already established a reputation for titanium case work and hand-finished polished blued surfaces before DB28 became the collection most associated with the brand.
narrative.collector_notes: Case material variants (titanium, zirconium, and mixed titanium-platinum) affect both weight and price meaningfully; collectors also check the mirror-polished, hand-finished bridges for the specific heat-blued treatment De Bethune developed in-house, since it ages and reflects differently from standard bluing.
